Psalm 100 Joshua 24:14–Judges 1:16; Luke 18:1–17

The Lord GOD has opened my ear, and I was not rebellious; I did not turn backward. Isaiah 50:5

She had a sister named Mary, who sat at Jesus’s feet and listened to what he was saying. Luke 10:39

Lord, there are moments that require stillness and moments that require busyness. Amen.
